quote.text: But what master, I wonder, do you yourself serve? Money? Women? Boys? The emperor or one of his subordinates? It has to be one of them, or you wouldn’t fret about such things.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Recognize that the values you instill in your children set the foundation for their character – serve virtue and wisdom rather than transient desires like wealth or mere appearances.
    • Lead by example in self-control and mindfulness; your children learn from your allegiance, so make it one that emphasizes integrity over fleeting temptations.
  • Leadership:
    • A true leader is one who serves a higher purpose, not the vanity of power or the allure of external validation; examine if your decisions are ruled by principle instead of the pursuit of status.
    • Embrace the stoic practice of self-awareness, ensuring that your actions are driven by a commitment to the common good, not by the misguided worship of money or influence.
  • Product Management:
    • In product management, let your guiding master be the enduring values of quality and user trust rather than the ephemeral chase of market trends or profit margins.
    • Maintain a clear vision that prioritizes long-term value over short-term gains, aligning your decisions with the principles of rationality and ethical commitment.
